columns.label: ET₀ (mm/day)
columns.name: ET₀
columns.note: plausible 1–7.4 mm/day (the 4_4 table's ET₀ is withheld)

columns.label: NDVI
columns.name: NDVI
columns.note: passes the NDVI plausibility check (arid west low, wet east high, seasonal cycle follows the rains)

columns.label: Rootzone Soil Moisture (m³/m³)
columns.name: Rootzone Soil Moisture
columns.note: Served from Mar 2015: one constant value per district from 2001 to Feb 2015 (a fill before the satellite record); real monthly values from Mar 2015

columns.label: Surface Soil Moisture (m³/m³)
columns.name: Surface Soil Moisture
columns.note: Served from Mar 2015: one constant value per district from 2001 to Feb 2015 (a fill before the satellite record); real monthly values from Mar 2015

columns.label: Surface Water Extent (km²)
columns.name: Surface Water Extent
columns.note: plausibility checked 2026-10-15: ≥ 0 everywhere, different in every district

columns.label: SGI
columns.name: SGI
columns.note: Served May 2002 – Aug 2024 only: values after Aug 2024 repeat Aug 2024 and are withheld; Jan 2001 – Apr 2002 is a constant spin-up. Johannesburg, Ekurhuleni, Sedibeng and West Rand share one identical series, as do Sisonke and uMgungundlovu

columns.label: Growing Degree Days GDD (°C·days)
columns.name: Growing Degree Days GDD
columns.note: = Σ daily max(Tavg − 10 °C, 0) from 4_1 (624 / 624 district-months of 2015 match): degree-days

columns.label: Daily Rainfall Total (mm)
columns.name: Daily Rainfall Total
columns.note: complete calendar incl. 31 Dec

columns.label: Number of Rainy Days (days/month)
columns.name: Number of Rainy Days
columns.note: = days ≥ 1 mm (verified)

columns.label: CHIRPS Daily Rainfall Estimate (mm/day)
columns.name: CHIRPS Daily Rainfall Estimate
columns.note: = Daily_Rainfall_Total_mm × 0.95–1.05 (r = 1.000): derived from the gauge series, not an independent estimate

columns.label: TAMSAT Satellite Rainfall Estimate (mm/dekad)
columns.name: TAMSAT Satellite Rainfall Estimate
columns.note: one value per district-month (mm per dekad, ≈ monthly total ÷ 3, r = 0.998), repeated on every daily row

columns.label: Hourly Rainfall Intensity (mm/h)
columns.name: Hourly Rainfall Intensity
columns.note: = daily total × 0.15–0.20 (r = 1.000): a proxy, not gauge-measured hourly intensity

columns.label: Soil Moisture Prior (m³/m³)
columns.name: Soil Moisture Prior
columns.note: plausibility checked 2026-10-15: 0.025–0.475 m³/m³, varying

columns.label: Runoff Anomaly (%)
columns.name: Runoff Anomaly
columns.note: = (month's modelled runoff − same-month mean of all months 2000–2026) / that mean (r = 1.00000 with runoff_variables_master); the baseline includes the partial year 2026, as the DB's rainfall anomalies do

columns.label: Soil Moisture (m³/m³)
columns.name: Soil Moisture
columns.note: catchment soil moisture at the district's reservoirs (r = 0.74 with the satellite surface soil moisture)

columns.label: Rainfall (mm/day)
columns.name: Rainfall
columns.note: catchment rainfall at the district's reservoirs; a different series from 6.1 daily rainfall (r = 0.56, same value on 24 % of days); Served up to Aug 2026: from 1 Sep 2026 every district repeats its 31 August value on every day (a forward fill, not observations)

columns.label: Daily Mean Flow (m³/day)
columns.name: Daily Mean Flow
columns.note: m³/day (spec §9.1); the flow family consistent with the database's MAR (16_1): summed over the districts ≈ 40 700 Mm³/year (16_1 MAR ≈ 66 300)

columns.label: Daily Sediment Load (t/day)
columns.name: Daily Sediment Load
columns.note: = daily mean flow × suspended sediment concentration (checked)

columns.label: River Discharge Q (m³/s)
columns.name: River Discharge Q
columns.note: Served from Jan 2026: before Jan 2026 the column holds a monthly mean that contradicts the daily flows (1/63 of them on average); from Jan 2026 it is the daily mean flow / 86 400 s, as a discharge should be

columns.label: Stage Height (m)
columns.name: Stage Height
columns.note: 74 % of months at 0.05 m, the series' lowest value

columns.label: Groundwater Table Depth (m bgl)
columns.name: Groundwater Table Depth
columns.note: NGA telemetry (irregular days, about every 7 weeks); the same 202 dates in every district

columns.label: Hydraulic Head (m amsl)
columns.name: Hydraulic Head
columns.note: monthly (15th), source: DWS National Groundwater Archive & DEM interpolation; one of two hydraulic-head series (r = 0.06 between them, 363 m apart on average)

columns.label: Hydraulic Head (m amsl)
columns.name: Hydraulic Head
columns.note: NGA telemetry (irregular days); the unit column says 'm bgl', but the values (448–1 638 m) are elevations as the name says: a water level 1 638 m below ground is impossible in South Africa's aquifers. One of two hydraulic-head series (r = 0.06 between them)

columns.label: Depth to Water Table (m bgl)
columns.name: Depth to Water Table
columns.note: City of Cape Town, Eden, iLembe, Nelson Mandela Bay, Overberg and West Coast share one identical series

columns.label: Evapotranspiration (mm)
columns.name: Evapotranspiration
columns.note: City of Cape Town, Eden, iLembe, Nelson Mandela Bay, Overberg and West Coast share one identical series

columns.label: Spring Discharge (L/s)
columns.name: Spring Discharge
columns.note: City of Cape Town, Eden, iLembe, Nelson Mandela Bay, Overberg and West Coast share one identical series

columns.label: Electrical Conductivity (EC) (mS/m)
columns.name: Electrical Conductivity (EC)
columns.note: TDS = 4.2–6.7 × EC in this table (r = 1.000), as expected for natural waters

columns.label: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) (mg/L)
columns.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
columns.note: = 4.2–6.7 × EC in this table (r = 1.000), as expected for natural waters

columns.label: Ammonia NH3 N (mg/L)
columns.name: Ammonia NH3 N
columns.note: Values below 0 are not served: a concentration cannot be negative (2 of 16 744 rows)

columns.label: Aquatic Habitat Integrity
columns.name: Aquatic Habitat Integrity
columns.note: Values outside 0–100 are not served: a score on a 0–100 scale (1 row below 0 and 2 above 100 in 16 744)

columns.label: ASPT
columns.name: ASPT
columns.note: Values below 0 are not served: an average score per taxon cannot be negative (1 row in 16 744)

columns.label: Ecological Reserve Q (m³/s)
columns.name: Ecological Reserve Q
columns.note: Values below 0 are not served: a flow requirement cannot be negative (1 row in 16 744)

columns.label: FIBI
columns.name: FIBI
columns.note: Values outside 0–100 are not served: a score on a 0–100 scale (1 row below 0 and 2 above 100 in 16 744)

columns.label: Riparian Vegetation
columns.name: Riparian Vegetation
columns.note: Values outside 0–100 are not served: a score on a 0–100 scale (1 row below 0 and 2 above 100 in 16 744)

columns.label: SASS5 Score
columns.name: SASS5 Score
columns.note: Values below 0 are not served: a SASS5 score cannot be negative (1 row in 16 744)

body.note: Live numeric columns with a daily or monthly resolution. Withheld and duplicate columns cannot be forecast; annual columns hold too few values.
